value.syntax: # [doc = " The assignment operator, kept because the two augmenting forms mean"] # [doc = " something the plain form does not."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " `assignt = \"=\" / \"/=\"` and `assigng = \"=\" / \"//=\"`: `=` defines,"] # [doc = " `/=` adds a type choice to an existing name, `//=` adds a group choice."] # [doc = " The augmenting forms are what makes the socket/plug convention of"] # [doc = " RFC 8610 Section 3.9 work."] # [derive (Copy , Clone , Debug , PartialEq , Eq)] pub (crate) enum Assign { # [doc = " `=`"] Plain , # [doc = " `/=`, adding an alternative to a type choice."] TypeChoice , # [doc = " `//=`, adding an alternative to a group choice."] GroupChoice , }
